rounds: I like an artist less when they advertise a product.
I'd rather pay €150 to see a big star than €20 for a band I don't know.
Brand logos on stage ruin the atmosphere of a concert.
Influencers should have to say how much they were paid for a post.
Reselling a concert ticket for profit is fine if someone is happy to pay.
Artists should talk about politics at their concerts.
Energy-drink brands shouldn't be allowed to sponsor events for teenagers.
I'd wear a T-shirt with a brand's logo on it if they gave it to me for free.
